moduleG_deterministicTriadicClosure.name: Deterministic Triadic Closure
moduleG_deterministicTriadicClosure.replaces: legacy Module G MCMC/NUTS parameter assimilation
moduleG_deterministicTriadicClosure.interpretation: Module G derives the active RFC packet from CIF-QV-RFL closure conditions before empirical comparison. Observational datasets are downstream validation contexts only.

moduleR_triadGroupedGlobalClosureAudit.name: Triad-Grouped Global Closure Audit
moduleR_triadGroupedGlobalClosureAudit.interpretation: Module R shows that apparent RFL residual structure improves when treated as source-coupled to QV, CIF, RFL, CP, observer, dark-kernel, and collapse-rebirth channels. Closure is overwhelmingly QV-dominant.

moduleN_V2_dimensionalProjectionBridge.name: Dimensional Projection Bridge
moduleN_V2_dimensionalProjectionBridge.interpretation: Module N V2 makes projection dimension-aware. The raw inverse-energy value is an internal RFC projected quantity and is not directly claimed as the physical inverse fine-structure constant.

combinedDownstreamPhysicalProjectionScre.interpretation: The frozen packet propagates through dark-sector, CP, BBN proxy, observer, collapse-rebirth, and geometry screens without retuning. These are internal/projected RFC-unit screens, not final external laboratory validation.

dimensionlessObservableValidationLayer.interpretation: Dimensionless validation passes internally before SI calibration or external comparison.

moduleS_oneAnchorSI_LaboratoryBridge.name: One-Anchor SI / Laboratory Bridge
moduleS_oneAnchorSI_LaboratoryBridge.interpretation: Module S establishes unit translation only. It does not prove all laboratory constants.
